### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                    |
| ----- | ------ | -------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | end, conclusion            |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to finish, to end (in/tr.) |
| ~an   | *adj.* | final, last                |
### Implied meaning
- past
- former, ex-
### Antonym
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Time/ksun\|ksun]]
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- 了, showing the end of a rolled object (perhaps a string or plant)
- added a knife to signify cutting off, and hence, ending.
#### Sound
- *a priori:*
